searchText: Thanks for the notes! Appreciate you taking the time… does sound a little sub optimal with beacon block body…. Sounds like a couple of considerations before we go ahead and merge it… Also not a huge fan of the `eip4844` naming... it'd be nice to know when it'll land properly but that may not get sorted at this point until late Jan... I think i could live with the json definition not being strictly ordered so added a suggestion of moving bls_to_execution into the common definition I wonder what peoples appetite is for merging it as `eip4844` and removing `eip4844` once we have a real name for it? I wouldn’t mind this. Should just be a `sed` over the whole spec repo 😅 yep pretty much, probably need to match case, maybe 2 sed's 🙂
